summary: Implemented a real exp(x: f32) -> f32 builtin lowering to the SPIR-V GLSL.std.450 extended instruction Exp (=27) — the FIRST OpExtInstImport "GLSL.std.450" + OpExtInst ever emitted by the codegen. Modeled VERBATIM on the M3.5 f32_to_f16 unary builtin precedent across HIR/typecheck/codegen. The GLSL.std.450 import is emitted ONCE per module via a cached set-id (the load-bearing codegen-correctness point). NO new SPIR-V capability. Removes the M3.2b FlashAttention-2 Taylor near-uniform limitation: real-range LLM attention (post-max logit spreads -10..0) is now numerically correct.

implementation_notes.hir: New ExtInstBuiltin::Exp (source_name "exp", arity 1, return_ty F32, glsl450_opcode 27) + RESERVED_EXT_INST_BUILTIN_NAMES/is_reserved_ext_inst_builtin. New HirExprKind::ExtInstBuiltin { op, args } alongside Q4_0Builtin. Module wired in lib.rs + re-exported.
implementation_notes.typecheck: check_ext_inst_call (modeled on the F32ToF16 arm) dispatched FIRST in check_call before q4_0/coopmat/subgroup. New ExpArgMustBeF32 + ExtInstBuiltinWrongArity + ReservedExtInstBuiltinName errors. Reserved-name guard extended so `let exp` is rejected. find_mul_add_in_expr recurses into the new arm (exhaustiveness).
implementation_notes.codegen: emit_exp(b, tc, glsl450_set, x_id) -> OpExtInst %f32 %set 27 %x via ext_inst(f32_ty, None, set, 27, [Operand::IdRef(x_id)]). ScalarTypeCache gains glsl450_set_id: Option<Word> + get_or_emit_glsl450_set lazy accessor (the proven u32_const_cache Option pattern — emit import once, cache, reuse). emit_exp takes NO &mut CapabilitiesRequired. emit_expr ExtInstBuiltin arm emits the arg first, fetches the cached set, then emits OpExtInst. Four emit.rs expr-scan predicates (gid/local-invocation-id/subgroup/coopmat) gained recursing ExtInstBuiltin arms for exhaustiveness.
